name: FluidSIM: input and output ports
description: A FluidSIM circuit that is the controller, with input and output port components: each input of the PLC goes to the same bit of an input port, %IX1.3 to EB1.bit.3, and each output comes from the same bit of an output port, %QX0.2 from AB0.bit.2. Signals the station does not use need no port.

endpoint.title: Server address
endpoint.description: opc.tcp:// and the computer FluidSIM runs on, with the port its OPC UA server is set to

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The namespace of FluidSIM's nodes, as ns=<index> or nsu=<URI>: ns=2 for FluidSIM
